messages:
Mira: Quick brainstorm  were launching a hands-on lab to drive PLG activation. Core hook: complete the 20-min lab, get a prompt-template pack + $25 starter credits. Need: inbound routing, benchmark signals, comms calendar, and post-event nudges.
Jon: Love it. Two asks: partner co-hosts for credibility, and a shareable partner link that injects partner_id + utm.
Priya: Routing plan idea: tag submissions with 'lab_starter', then rule by company_size and intent_score. If company_size > 100 or intent_score > 80 -> route to enterprise-sales; else -> growth-nurture. Webhook to SFDC for enterprise. Pseudo: 
```
if submission.tag == "lab_starter":
  if submission.company_size > 100 or submission.intent_score >= 80:
    assign_queue = "enterprise-sales"
  else:
    assign_queue = "growth-nurture"
  notify_channels = ["#sales-inbound", "#growth-inbound"]
```
Leo: Growth ops note: expect a 48-72h surge after the event. Recommend scheduling a rotating SDR buddy (Mon-Fri after event) and enabling a Slack digest for high-intent leads only.
Kelly: Measurement: primary KPI = % of attendees who call the API with the provided template within 24h. Secondary KPIs = day-7 reuse rate and 14-day paid conversion. We'll need instrumented UTM/session flags so analytics can attribute correctly.
Sasha: Comms plan: 2-week cadence: invite blast (LinkedIn + email), reminder + partner mail, day-of SMS (for registered), and 3 nudges after the lab (0h: credits email, 24h: quick tips, 7d: template refresh). A/B test two email subject lines and two landing copy variants.
Mira: Subject options: A) "Hands-on: Ship an LLM flow in 20 minutes" B) "Try Redwood: lab + templates + credits". Landing copy variants: technical-first vs outcome-first.
Jon: Partner link example: https://redwood.ai/lab?partner_id=mosaic&utm_source=partner&utm_campaign=lab-launch. Can we auto-apply credits only after a short verification script in the lab?
Priya: Yes  we'll require a final-step submit with token verification. Credits assigned via backend job that checks completion state. Also: add partner_id to lead payload so partner-sourced leads appear in our reports.
growth-bot: Playbook stub created: /playbooks/lab-starter-routing (status: draft).
Mira: Tasks: Jon finalize partner assets + share speaker bio by Thu. Priya implement routing + webhook + partner param by Tue. Kelly deck + KPI dashboard by Wed. Sasha comms calendar + SMS vendor. Leo schedule SDR coverage + generate Slack alert template.
Jon: I'll confirm Mosaic and ask for co-mail copy.
Priya: Routing PR target Tue AM. Will include unit tests for the rule matrix.
Kelly: Dashboard mock by Wed EOD, will include funnel breakdown by partner and non-partner cohorts.
Mira: Quick vote for workshop time  Tue 9am PT (:one:) or Thu 11am PT (:two:). React with emoji.
Kelly: :one:
Sasha: :two:
Leo: :one:
Mira: Going with Tue 9am PT. I'll send invites and a short checklist for the lab flow. Thanks everyone.
